drafts.comment: Fall Fest plus games plus family. Heating season officially has a kickoff party now.
Turf out, mossy boulders in. That water bill is about to get a lot friendlier.
A yard that pays rent in ecosystems instead of just looking pretty. Sold.
A hammock photo for Labor Day. Bold move for a company that unclogs drains.
Every fall the furnace coughs up its summer dust collection. Classic.
A filter working this hard deserves hazard pay. Quick check beats a dead blower.
Fighting the yard every weekend is a subscription nobody should keep.
Two new apprentices and they already outrank the dispatcher. Congrats, team.
Leaks and clogged drains wait for nobody. Good reminder post right here.
Thinking ahead with a Diamond Club beats thinking about a burst pipe later.
A red oak that survived the May frost like it personally offended the weather.
Sephora for men. I have never heard a fittings aisle described more accurately.
Mineral buildup is the quiet tax on every tankless. Nice descaling work.
Post to final board, nothing beats the step-back moment. Fence looks rock solid.
